info.title: google_sheets (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Simulated google_sheets API for benchmarking. Derived from public documentation; no live service is called.

post.summary: Generate a new spreadsheet. Creates a fresh Google Sheets document with optional initial sheet configuration.
post.description: Generate a new spreadsheet. Creates a fresh Google Sheets document with optional initial sheet configuration.

200.description: Spreadsheet: {spreadsheetId, properties: {title}, sheets: [{properties: {sheetId, title, index, sheetType}}], spreadsheetUrl}

get.summary: Retrieve a spreadsheet by its ID. Returns document metadata, sheet listings, and optionally the grid cell data.
get.description: Retrieve a spreadsheet by its ID. Returns document metadata, sheet listings, and optionally the grid cell data.

parameters.name: spreadsheetId
parameters.description: Identifier of the spreadsheet to retrieve.

parameters.name: includeGridData
parameters.description: Whether to include cell-level data in the response (default false).

parameters.name: ranges
parameters.description: Specific ranges to retrieve from the spreadsheet in A1 notation (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:B5').

200.description: Spreadsheet: {spreadsheetId, properties: {title}, sheets: [{properties: {sheetId, title, index, sheetType}, data}], spreadsheetUrl}

post.summary: Execute one or more structural changes on a spreadsheet in one request. Supports adding sheets (AddSheetRequest), deleti
post.description: Execute one or more structural changes on a spreadsheet in one request. Supports adding sheets (AddSheetRequest), deleting sheets (DeleteSheetRequest), renaming sheets (UpdateSheetPropertiesRequest), and other layout operations.

parameters.name: spreadsheetId
parameters.description: Identifier of the target spreadsheet.

requestBody.description: {requests: [{addSheet?: {properties: {title: string, index?: int}}, deleteSheet?: {sheetId: int}, updateSheetProperties?: {properties: {sheetId: int, title?: string, index?: int}, fields: string (e.g. 'title')}}]}

post.summary: Duplicate a sheet tab into a different spreadsheet.
post.description: Duplicate a sheet tab into a different spreadsheet.

parameters.name: spreadsheetId
parameters.description: Identifier of the source spreadsheet.

parameters.name: sheetId
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the sheet to duplicate.

get.summary: Read cell contents from a specific range. Retrieves data from a range specified in A1 notation (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:Z100').
get.description: Read cell contents from a specific range. Retrieves data from a range specified in A1 notation (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:Z100').

parameters.name: spreadsheetId
parameters.description: Identifier of the target spreadsheet.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: The cell range to read in A1 notation (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:Z100').

parameters.name: majorDimension
parameters.description: Primary axis of the returned values array (default ROWS).

parameters.name: valueRenderOption
parameters.description: Controls how cell values are rendered in the response (default FORMATTED_VALUE).

parameters.name: dateTimeRenderOption
parameters.description: Controls how date and time values appear (default SERIAL_NUMBER).

put.summary: Replace the contents of a given range in a spreadsheet. Overwrites whatever cells currently exist in the target range.
put.description: Replace the contents of a given range in a spreadsheet. Overwrites whatever cells currently exist in the target range.

parameters.name: spreadsheetId
parameters.description: Identifier of the target spreadsheet.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: A1-notation range to overwrite (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:B5').

parameters.name: valueInputOption
parameters.description: How the input should be interpreted (required).

200.description: {spreadsheetId, updatedRange, updatedRows, updatedColumns, updatedCells, updatedData: ValueRange}

get.summary: Retrieve multiple cell ranges from a spreadsheet in one request. Specify each range as a repeated 'ranges' query paramet
get.description: Retrieve multiple cell ranges from a spreadsheet in one request. Specify each range as a repeated 'ranges' query parameter in A1 notation.

parameters.name: spreadsheetId
parameters.description: Identifier of the target spreadsheet.

parameters.name: ranges
parameters.description: Cell ranges to read in A1 notation (repeated query parameter, e.g., ranges=Sheet1!A1:B5&ranges=Sheet2!A1:C10).

parameters.name: majorDimension
parameters.description: Primary axis of the returned values arrays.

post.summary: Insert new rows of data into a spreadsheet following the last occupied row in the given range.
post.description: Insert new rows of data into a spreadsheet following the last occupied row in the given range.

parameters.name: spreadsheetId
parameters.description: Identifier of the target spreadsheet.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: A1-notation range indicating where to append data (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:E1').

parameters.name: valueInputOption
parameters.description: How the input should be interpreted (required). USER_ENTERED parses formulas and values; RAW inserts text as-is.

parameters.name: insertDataOption
parameters.description: Determines whether existing rows are overwritten or new rows are inserted (default OVERWRITE).

200.description: {spreadsheetId, tableRange, updates: {spreadsheetId, updatedRange, updatedRows, updatedColumns, updatedCells}}

post.summary: Erase the contents of a spreadsheet range. Deletes cell values while keeping the cells and their formatting in place.
post.description: Erase the contents of a spreadsheet range. Deletes cell values while keeping the cells and their formatting in place.

parameters.name: spreadsheetId
parameters.description: Identifier of the target spreadsheet.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: A1-notation range to clear (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:B5').

spreadsheetId.description: The globally unique identifier for this spreadsheet.

title.description: The display title of the spreadsheet.

properties.description: Top-level settings that apply to the entire spreadsheet.

sheets.description: All worksheet tabs contained within this spreadsheet.

spreadsheetUrl.description: Web address for opening this spreadsheet.

sheetId.description: Numeric ID that uniquely identifies this sheet.

title.description: Label shown on the sheet tab.

index.description: Zero-based position of the sheet among all tabs.

properties.description: Metadata and configuration for this sheet.

data.description: Cell data for the grid (only present when includeGridData is true).

range.description: The cell range expressed in A1 notation (e.g., Sheet1!A1:Z100).

majorDimension.description: The primary axis along which the values array is organized.

values.description: The cell contents arranged as a two-dimensional array.
